title: Boston Scientific Registry of Deep Brain Stimulation for Treatment of Essential Tremor (ET)
official: Boston Scientific Registry of Deep Brain Stimulations for Treatment of Essential Tremor (ET):ET Registry
summary: To compile characteristics of real-world outcomes for Boston Scientific Corporation's commercially approved Deep Brain Stimulation (DBS) Systems, when used according to the applicable Directions for Use, for the treatment of Essential Tremor.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Meets criteria established in the locally applicable Directions for Use (DFU) for Essential Tremor
* Is at least 18 years old

Exclusion Criteria:

* Meets any contraindication in locally applicable Directions for Use
